notes: SoothToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Sooth Protocol (SOOTH) with 18 decimals. Its zero-argument constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 SOOTH once to msg.sender, the deploying factory. It has no administrative roles, subsequent minting, or transfer fees. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
